ponder.gtsnponder.catalog.title: Ponder Catalog
ponder.gtsnponder.coke_oven.narration.co: The controller sits in the front-center. Power it to form the structure.
ponder.gtsnponder.coke_oven.narration.in: This is the coke oven: a 3x3x3 multiblock that turns coal into coke.
ponder.gtsnponder.coke_oven.narration.us: Feed coal from the top, then collect coke and creosote from the output hatch.
ponder.gtsnponder.coke_oven.title: Coke Oven
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_assembly_li: Power the energy hatch to run it.
The input bus goes at the starting slice and takes up to 16 items and 4 fluids.
Products come out of the output bus at the far end - one item per craft.
Common pitfalls: it has a research slot, so many recipes need data researched first - bring a data hatch.
The Assembly Line is an oversized Assembler for mass-producing advanced crafting components.
It is built from repeatable slices - 5 to 16 of them - and a longer line handles more recipes.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_cleanroom.e: It draws very little power: about 30 EU/t while dirty and about 4 EU/t once clean.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_cleanroom.i: Items, fluids and power pass through passthrough hatches, Hulls or Diodes in the walls.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_cleanroom.o: The room produces nothing itself; the machines inside do the work.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_cleanroom.p: Common pitfalls: at most 4 doors, and generators, mufflers, drills and primitive machines are too dirty to place inside.
The Cleanroom does not process anything itself - it lets machines placed inside run cleanroom-only recipes.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_cleanroom.s: It is a sealed room from 5x5x5 to 15x15x15, with Cleanroom Filter casings in the ceiling.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_coke_oven.e: It uses no power at all - a primitive machine from before the steam age.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_coke_oven.i: Drop coal into the hollow center from the top or through a loading hatch.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_coke_oven.o: The coke stays in the chamber and creosote collects in the machine's built-in 32-bucket tank.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_coke_oven.p: Common pitfalls: the structure must be all Coke Oven Bricks and at most 5 Coke Oven Hatches; the creosote tank holds only 32 buckets, so drain it when full.
The Coke Oven turns coal into coke and yields creosote as a by-product - your first multiblock.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_coke_oven.s: Build a hollow 3x3x3 out of Coke Oven Bricks and fit the controller; it needs no power and no fuel.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_distillatio: Power the energy hatch; a taller tower can run more recipes.
Feed the source fluid in at the bottom - one fluid at a time.
Each upper layer's output hatch yields a different fraction - up to 12 fluids.
Common pitfalls: starting from the second layer, every layer must have exactly one output hatch or it will not form.
The Distillation Tower fractionates fluids like oil into many products - the heart of petrochemistry.
It is built from repeated tower layers, and every layer needs its own output hatch so each fraction can be collected separately.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_electric_bl: Power the energy input hatch at the matching tier; a higher voltage supports higher furnace temperatures.
Feed ores or ingredients through the input bus; fluids can also be piped in for the reaction.
Collect the products from the output bus; ash can be recovered through the muffler hatch.
Common pitfalls: fit a muffler hatch with an air block in front of it, and low-tier coils cannot reach the temperatures some recipes need.
The Electric Blast Furnace smelts advanced materials such as aluminium, stainless steel and titanium - a key mid-game machine.
It needs heating coils for temperature: power the controller to form it, and higher-tier coils allow higher furnace temperatures.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_gas_large_t: It is an EV-tier generator; hook the output energy hatch to your grid.
Feed flammable gas into the input hatch.
It only produces EU - no item or fluid output.
Common pitfalls: the turbine rotor wears out and must be replaced; leave an air block in front of the muffler or the turbine face gets obstructed and efficiency drops.
The Large Gas Turbine burns flammable gas to produce EU - a mainstay generator of the EV age.
It needs a turbine rotor in the rotor holder, plus gearbox casings and a muffler hatch.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_large_chemi: Power the energy input hatch; overclocking raises both speed and energy use.
Feed ingredients through the input bus - up to 3 items and 5 fluids at once.
Collect products from the output bus - up to 3 items and 4 fluids.
Common pitfalls: exactly one Cupronickel Coil is required - too many or too few will not form; with environmental hazards enabled it also demands a safe environment.
The Large Chemical Reactor runs Chemical Reactor recipes at 100% energy efficiency - built for bulk chemistry.
The key to forming it is exactly one Cupronickel Coil Block next to the PTFE pipe at the center.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_large_mixer: Power it at the matching tier; adding a parallel control hatch processes more at once.
It accepts up to 6 items and 2 fluids at once.
Collect the mixture from the output - usually one item or one fluid.
Common pitfalls: too many ingredient types will stall it; a parallel hatch boosts throughput but also energy use.
The Large Mixer blends materials into alloys and mixtures, made for bulk production.
Build the casing and I/O hatches as shown; power it to form.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_centrifu: It is an LV machine - connect a low-voltage cable or generator.
Put the item or fluid to separate into the input.
Collect the separated parts from the outputs - up to 6 items and 6 fluids.
Common pitfalls: separation yields many outputs, so a full output slot stalls it - keep them cleared.
The Basic Centrifuge spins mixed materials apart to separate their components.
The whole machine is this one block; place it and power it to use it.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_compress: It is an LV machine - connect a low-voltage cable or generator.
Put the item to compress into the input slot.
Take the compressed product from the output slot.
Common pitfalls: do not confuse it with the Implosion Compressor - that is an explosive-consuming multiblock for special materials.
The Basic Compressor squeezes items into denser forms, such as turning ingots into blocks.
The whole machine is this one block; place it and power it to use it.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_electrol: It is an LV machine - connect a low-voltage cable or generator.
Put the item or fluid to electrolyze into the input.
Collect the elements from the outputs - up to 6 items and 6 fluids.
Common pitfalls: electrolysis yields many products, so the outputs fill up quickly - leave room to collect them.
The Basic Electrolyzer uses electricity to break items or fluids down into their elements.
The whole machine is this one block; place it and power it to use it.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_macerato: It is an LV machine - connect a low-voltage cable or generator.
Put the ore into the input slot.
Take the dust from the output slot.
Common pitfalls: LV and MV macerators have only one output slot and cannot produce by-products - go HV or higher for those.
The Basic Macerator grinds ores into dusts - the first workhorse of the electric age.
The whole machine is this one block; place it and power it to use it.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.en: It is an LV machine - connect a low-voltage cable or generator.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.in: It accepts up to 6 items and 2 fluids at once.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.ou: Take the mixture from the output slot.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.pi: Common pitfalls: there is a cap on ingredient types; recipes needing more should use the Large Mixer.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.pu: The Basic Mixer blends several ingredients into alloys or mixtures.
ponder.gtsnponder.desc.gtceu_lv_mixer.se: The whole machine is this one block; place it and power it to use it.

ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.ca: Cables carry EU between generators, transformers and machines - pick a cable for the voltage and amperage you need.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.co: The controller turns the structure into a working machine; only then can the network connect.
Covers mount on machines and pipes: conveyor (items), pump (fluids), machine controller (auto I/O) and more.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.fl: Fluid pipes move fluids; larger pipes have higher throughput, and a pump cover or valve lets fluid in or out.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.narration.it: Item pipes move items between inventories: use a conveyor module to extract from a source and route to the destination.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.pump.narrati: This is %s - it pumps fluids out of the world into pipes and tanks.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.pump.title: Logistics: Primitive Pump
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.tank.narrati: This is %s - a fluid storage multiblock; it anchors the fluid side of your logistics network.
ponder.gtsnponder.logistics.tank.title: Logistics: Steel Multiblock Tank

ponder.gtsnponder.power.combustion.narra: This is %s - a generator that burns fuel to produce EU for the power grid.

ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.burnin: Cable burning: a cable carrying more current than its gauge allows burns out - size the cable (1x / 2x / 4x...) to the amperage.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.contro: The controller is the front-center block: supply the correct voltage to form the structure.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.overvo: Overvoltage: feeding a machine a tier above its rating quadruples its energy cost and can damage or destroy it.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.narration.voltag: GT power comes in voltage tiers (ULV, LV, MV, HV...). A machine only accepts its own tier; a transformer converts between tiers.
ponder.gtsnponder.power.transformer.narr: This is %s - it steps energy between voltage tiers so machines join the right grid.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lp_steam_furnace: This is the Low Pressure Steam Furnace - a bronze-age smelter that runs on steam.
Feed in ore or food and plenty of steam: it smelts one item at a time and needs no power cable.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lv_macerator.int: This is the Basic Macerator - the LV workhorse that grinds ores into dusts.
ponder.gtsnponder.usage.lv_macerator.usa: Put ore in the input slot, give it LV power, and pull the dust from the output slot.
